messages.text: Apps I made in Codex using open source stuff I found on GitHub. I’ve never done anything like it before.

messages.text: Pick your federation and year. Watch any and every episode in order.

messages.text: Go to HELP and generate a sync code. Then use that sync code anywhere else you’re watching and it remember where you left off, your queue, your history, etc.
